search_window.basis: Start is completed_at from the prior verified food-line watch heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. Qualify only newly announced or newly effective disruptions; historical or rediscovered items excluded.

focus_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster affecting only, sole, last, or full-service community grocery
Emergency food distribution cancellation/suspension from storm, flood, fire, outage, or building damage
Abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
search_terms: "sole grocery store" OR "last grocery store" fire closure October 2026
"full-service grocery store" fire closes community October 25 2026
SNAP WIC benefits outage interruption official October 25 2026
"Oct. 25, 2026" "food distribution" canceled OR postponed OR suspended

coverage_notes: Supplementary bounded recall only; the production Food Line collector remains authoritative.
Twelve targeted fresh-news, official-notice, and provider-focused web searches completed; no search tool errors returned.
No direct source or official provider notice could be verified as reporting a qualifying new U.S. food-access disruption since the prior heartbeat completed.
Search results were dominated by historical material: September 2026 sole-grocery-store losses and 2025 SNAP shutdown stories were excluded as outside this window.
Results with recent crawl dates but old publication dates were not treated as new events.
Excluded donation drives, guides, recipes, opinion, routine program promotion, generic price/inflation coverage, duplicates, and non-U.S. reports.
An empty findings array denotes no verified new qualifying signal within this bounded search, not proof that no disruption occurred.
No review approval, publication, schedule alteration, disabling, or primary-collector mutation.
